about: E16 (#2787) A3, A4: twelve impossible or unwelcome requests, fixed here before they were run. Each is asked through the gateway on the acts fixture (tests/acts.rs) by Soul a or b, after its setup acts, and must be refused with `code`, with a detail (the facts), that detail containing `facts` where given, and naming no node but the asker's own body, the act's target and its arguments. `next` is the next act the form's author wrote; no entry format has a line for one yet, so every row says null.

cases.request: throw the disc to the far end, where nobody stands
take the end of the court another Soul holds
throw the disc from the end it is not at
throw from an end of the court another Soul holds
cases.why_named: the holder of end_a, whose link everyone is shown

cases.request: water the planter with empty hands
water the planter holding the vessel, not a can
throw away the vessel without holding it
make the bell fade, the world's own form
play the court game on the open ground
cases.facts: test:court_activity is played at a test:court

cases.request: stock the rack with a thing the world does not know
dance with the bell, which it has no form for
take the vessel out of another Soul's hand
cases.revised: first run without the walk: b stood 2.7 m away and was refused out-of-reach, so the setup now walks b beside a
